name: Haus Rinner Rosa
beschreibung: The inn Haus Rinner Rosa is located in a quiet side location in Tirol, nestled in a typical Alpine setting. The guest rooms are modern yet traditionally designed, with wooden furniture and comfortable beds. In the in-house restaurant, traditional dishes from Tirol are prepared using regional ingredients. For leisure activities, hiking trails, cycling routes, and ski areas in winter are available nearby. The personal and welcoming atmosphere of the family-run business ensures a pleasant stay.
